resources.title: Online assessment system with behavioural monitoring and oral defense workflow (Google Apps Script)

paragraphs: Online assessment system with behavioural monitoring and oral defense workflow (Google Apps Script)
Restricted access: the files of this record are restricted. You may request access to the files in this upload, provided that you fulfil the conditions below.

A lightweight online assessment system for university mathematics and physics courses, built on Google Apps Script and Google Sheets with a single-page web client. It supports individual randomized variants, automatic grading of numeric and multiple-choice answers, a live instructor panel with assistant roles, a room seating map, controlled pauses, and an integrated oral-defense workflow in which students may be asked to explain their written solutions. The system records basic behavioural signals during the test to support academic integrity, and is designed to run on free infrastructure for groups of about 30–80 students.
The pedagogical design, assessment model and specifications are by the author; the code was written with Claude (Anthropic) to the author’s specification
